name: @forgeax-extension/scene-generator
description: Scene Generator monorepo: shared runtime kernel plus Scene Script composition

scripts.build:packages: bun run --filter @forgeax/node-runtime build && bun run --filter @forgeax/i18n build && bun run --filter @forgeax/scene-authoring build && bun run --filter @forgeax/scene build && bun run --filter @forgeax/node-runtime-react build && bun run --filter @forgeax/project-generator build
scripts.build: bun run build:packages && bun run --filter './apps/*/backend' --if-present build && bun run --filter './apps/*/frontend' --if-present build
scripts.test:packaging: node --test scripts/standalone-plugin-dependencies.test.mjs scripts/ensure-workspace-packages.test.mjs scripts/runtime-identity.test.mjs scripts/release-tool-schemas.test.mjs scripts/stage-release-package.test.mjs scripts/generate-manifests.test.mjs scripts/release-tools.test.mjs scripts/packaged-resource-roots.test.mjs
scripts.pretypecheck: bun run --filter './packages/**' --if-present build && bun run build:vendor
scripts.test:extension: tsc -p extensions/scene-generator/tsconfig.json && bun run build:extension && node --test extensions/scene-generator/test/*.test.mjs
